text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, a computer uses training data to find patterns. This data includes examples with correct answers, so the computer can learn from them. The computer builds a model, which is like a set of rules it creates from the data. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. The quality of the model is measured by its accuracy, which shows how often its predictions are correct. Good training data usually leads to better results.
